messages:
marta: FYI — multiple customers (acct 342, acct 578) reporting 502s/stream aborts right after JWT key rotation at 03:14 UTC. Hosted API streaming sessions cut mid-token. Error seen by clients: 'upstream connect error or disconnect'.

sahil: which endpoint and trace ids? Any spike in 5xx on auth or ingress? :thinking: 

marta: endpoint: POST /v1/stream. Example trace id: tr-9a8b7c6d. From Envoy logs:
```
[2026-03-16T03:15:02.123Z] "POST /v1/stream HTTP/2" 502 UC (upstream connect error)
upstream: backend-authsvc.default.svc.cluster.local:443
```

ingrid: sounds like auth verification fanout — after rotation we had cache misses and concurrent verification spiked. H2 connection pools + keepalive may be saturated causing upstream resets. Any authsvc 429s?

kevin: checked metrics — h2 concurrent streams on edge spiked x6, connection pool exhaustion on Envoy -> 502s. Authsvc returned many 429s. Root cause hypothesis: thundering JWT validation when cache misses after rotation.

marta: Repro steps (minimal): ramp a small number of streaming clients with rotated-signed tokens; they hit authsvc and you see resets. Curl example to reproduce:
```
curl -v --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer <rotated-jwt>" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Clients observe TLS then immediate reset / broken pipe.

kevin: Quick mitigations: 1) enable fallback acceptance of old signing key in authsvc (toggle), 2) increase auth key cache TTL and pre-warm keys, 3) bump Envoy h2_conn_pool / max_connection settings and keepalive, 4) short-term rate-limit auth requests at edge to avoid thundering.

ops-bot: deploy job rotation-jwt-2026-03-16 completed at 03:14:10 UTC, rollout id r-20260316-07

sahil: I'll spin up a canary to warm keys and reduce fanout. @ingrid can you check Envoy conn pool and circuit-breaker settings on canary? @kevin prepare rollback playbook.

ingrid: increasing upstream_max_connections and lowering outlier detection sensitivity on canary now. Pushing config in ~5m.

kevin: rollback playbook ready (commands + contacts). Posting runbook to incident page.

marta: Customer note drafted. AIs: sahil (auth warm), ingrid (envoy config), kevin (runbook + customer comms). I'll monitor traces and escalate to SRE if not resolved in 15m. :eyes:

support-bot: Created ticket INC-20260316-342 linked to this thread.

marta: Status update: mitigation in progress, partial recovery for several customers after key warm. Will update in 10m.
